scope: Actual bootstrap/main/dungeon scene, actors and casts, captured as world-only camera views. Each saved environment is temporarily substituted for controlled visual comparison; assets are never saved. Camera aspect ratios are validated; HUD, safe area and physical-device responsiveness are not claimed.

opaquePixelOcclusion.method: Same frozen live frame, actual actor/effect renderers. Opaque foreground mask is the RGB-invariant intersection of black-matte and white-matte renders (all RGB deltas<=2); compare covered pixels with the full backdrop render at RGB tolerance3. Independent of RT alpha; canvases/unrelated world renderers transiently excluded.
